kept_lines: If you work a side-gig, are self-employed, or have 1099 Forms to file, look no further. A trusted Tax Pro near you will help you learn how to pay self-employment tax, assist with eligible deductions and write-offs such as a home office, car expenses, the 20% Qualified Business Income Deduction, and help get your finances sorted for bookkeeping.
We can help you report the taxable earnings if you receive $600 or more directly from clients (1099-NEC) or $5,000 or more from payment processors this year (1099-K).
